description: Create a new event on a Google Calendar calendar.

attendees.description: The email addresses of the event attendees, each added as an attendee.

calendar_id.description: The ID of the calendar to create the event on. Defaults to "primary" if omitted.

end.description: The end time of the event, as an RFC 3339 date-time string.

start.description: The start time of the event, as an RFC 3339 date-time string.

summary.description: The title (summary) of the new event.

name: create_event
